=== LANDED. Gerrit 1222/1223/1224/1225 all MERGED at LLM-Review+1 AND Verified+1, 0 unresolved. ===
Verified the landed content rather than trusting the submit: git diff HEAD gerrit/main is EMPTY, so
Gerrit's rebase-on-submit did not alter what was tested.

  1222 cc77: type reconciler transports as the port    (13 core modules + _backend note)
  1223 cc77: type dispatch_one's transport params      (incl. the module-size remedy)
  1224 cc77: guard against silently blind port params  (the AC5 test, +190 lines)
  1225 cc77: note both ways to pass the ratchet blind  (pyproject.toml + docs/architecture.md)

AC STATUS — 8/8 met, each with evidence recorded above:
  AC1 38 port params across 14 core modules annotated (29 were bare, 9 were Any). One deliberate
      Any remains: assert_transport_conforms, pinned by an assertion, reasoned above.
  AC2 reveal_type evidence for all 14 touched modules; 14/14 resolve to
      rebar._engine.rebar_reconciler._backend.TicketTransport. ZERO report Any.
  AC3 negative probe transcript recorded verbatim, including the ABSENCES that make it meaningful.
  AC4 complete finding list (4 attr-defined + 16 assignment) with each one's resolution. None
      widened to Any; none reverted to the shim path.
  AC5 guard test, mutation-verified RED against all three bad spellings on a real parameter, and
      GREEN on restore; failure is the check's own assertion, not an incidental error.
  AC6 TicketTransport / _TransportPortMeta / assert_transport_conforms proven BYTE-IDENTICAL by AST
      span comparison against origin/main. No existing test file touched.
  AC7 mypy src/rebar clean (413 files); reconciler suite 1821 passed UNEDITED; backend contract /
      capability / neutrality / port-completeness / DC-port / exception-contract 110 passed.
  AC8 both defeat routes recorded in pyproject.toml AND docs/architecture.md.

NOT CLOSING this ticket, and NOT signing its review — the review sidecar predates the plan rewrite,
so signing would certify a plan nobody reviewed. Left in_progress for the operator.

ONE THING FOUND AND NOT FIXED, worth its own ticket: none of the four capability call sites has a
runtime guard. The core calls add_comment / set_relationship unconditionally, while fetcher.py:553
and :590 DO gate get_comment_map / get_issuelinks_map behind hasattr. Safe today only because the
differ that fills the mutation is capability-gated upstream — an invariant nothing local asserts, and
one this story deliberately did not change (no behaviour change was in scope). A links-less transport
reaching those sites would AttributeError inside a broad 'except Exception', i.e. silently.
